seal.statement: Partition-key ordering has one complete owner: compareRoutingKeys supplies deterministic SQLite-BINARY-compatible UTF-8 TEXT/string order, including non-BMP keys, while preserving the already-landed numeric-vs-text-encoded-number order and exact typed mixed-space refusal; KeyRange, PartitionResolver, QueryGroup and both split/merge sort and adjacency consume that owner for partition keys, with no merge-adjacency raw relational partition-key comparator remaining.
